title: Colour wheel: six spaces
subject: Art & Design
unit: Spring 1: Colour mixing, food landscapes and a fruit pot (Muck, Mess & Mixtures)
source: Written for art/y2 lesson 3 (Colour wheel template, six spaces (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 3. Paint the three primary colours first (red, yellow, blue) in every other space. Then mix the secondary colours in the spaces between.

blocks.answers: red + yellow = orange; yellow + blue = green; blue + red = purple. Orange sits between red and yellow, green between yellow and blue, purple between blue and red.
